While official toxicology results from the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner’s Office are still pending, emergency dispatch logs indicate that 911 was called to Gerber's facility for a suspected overdose and cardiac arrest.

Oil prices moved lower after President Donald Trump said that U.S. officials had a "very good meeting" with Iran's delegation and that it lasted about three hours. articles.title_orig: Questions remain after grand jury declines indictment in Nolan Wells' death
articles.title_zh: Questions remain after grand jury declines indictment in Nolan Wells' death
articles.content_orig:
Questions remain after grand jury declines indictment in Nolan Wells' death
A Mississippi grand jury has decided there's not enough evidence to bring charges in the case of Nolan Wells, a Black teenager who was found dead off the Mississippi coast in early July. However, activists, attorneys and Wells' family are continuing to push for answers.
During a press conference Tuesday, civil rights attorney Ben Crump highlighted a detail mentioned in the medical examiner's report: the bruising on the back of Wells' head, which the report said was not a fatal injury.
"Nolan Wells' parents deserve answers," said Crump, who is representing Wells' family. He urged the district attorney to keep the investigation open. "What really happened to Nolan Wells? What caused the blunt force trauma to his head? That is the crux of the matter."
The fact that the grand jury didn't find enough evidence to charge someone with a crime "is not an answer to how 18-year-old Nolan Xavier Wells left for an outing with friends and never came home," the Rev. Al Sharpton, who led Wells' eulogy, wrote in a statement. "We will not confuse the absence of an indictment with the presence of an answer."
Following Crump's release of the independent autopsy report, the NAACP is pushing the district attorney's office to release its own report to the public.
"Nolan's family deserves nothing less than a full, fair, and independent investigation that is exhaustive and leaves no stone unturned," wrote Kristen Clarke, NAACP general counsel, in a statement. "We urge the District Attorney to continue the investigation, release the full autopsy report from the state's medical examiner, and make the investigative file public."
The grand jury, which met from Sept. 14 to Sept. 18, ultimately found that Wells' cause of death was undetermined and based on the condition of his body and where it was found, his death was "consistent with drowning."
"The Grand Jury finds no credible evidence to support the public allegations that any persons who rode to or from Horn Island on July 4, 2026 on the Triton, the Palm Beach, or the Tideline engaged in any criminal conduct related to the death of Mr. Wells," the report, which is partially redacted, reads.
The 23 jurors issued over 100 subpoenas, heard from over 40 witnesses and reviewed evidence ranging from GPS data to cellphone extractions to photos and videos from Horn Island, a barrier island off the coast of Mississippi.
Evidence reviewed also included findings from Crump's team, including a report of what was on Wells' cell phone.
However, Wells was the only Black teen among the group of friends that traveled to Horn Island on July 4, and his family has repeatedly questioned if the investigation would have gone differently with a white teenager.
In a recorded statement released Monday night with the grand jury report, Jackson County District Attorney Angel Myers McIlrath said those concerns are baseless.
"The family, the Crump team, and anyone close to Nolan knew that his disappearance and death were not the result of racial hate or violence," Myers McIllrath said. "Yet the flames of that narrative set against the backdrop of Mississippi's terrible history were fanned by both people who knew the truth and those who didn't."
From July 4 to grand jury report
Wells was found dead on Horn Island on July 6, two days after he boated there with several friends to celebrate Independence Day.
Wells was the only member of the group who failed to return from the island, and the report says he chose to stay, characterizing it as, "not unusual or suspicious for individuals to return from the island on boats they did not travel […] on."
"Nolan chose to stay on the island that day, and there is not a scintilla of evidence to contradict that," Myers McIlrath said in her recorded statement.
The grand jury report emphasized that despite "public assertions" that the teen was the only Black person on the island that day, those assertions were false and "led to misidentification, speculation, and rumors concerning the death of Mr. Wells."
The grand jury determined there had been a "thorough search" of Horn Island on July 5 before Wells' body was discovered the following day.
"The Grand Jury is confident that had his body been on the island at that time, it would have been discovered during the extensive search," the report reads.
Questions surrounding the state and independent autopsies
Dr. Roger Mitchell, the forensic pathologist who performed an independent autopsy, concluded along with the state medical examiner that the cause and manner of Wells' death is "undetermined" and that "drowning is a diagnosis of exclusion."
Crump has previously said that Mitchell did not have access to parts of Wells' body during the independent autopsy. But the grand jury report disputes that assertion, noting that Mitchell had full access to the body, with the exception of internal neck structures in the custody of the state medical examiner.
Bruises were found on Wells but were not considered fatal injuries. One was on the back of his head, which Crump addressed following the grand jury report Monday night.
"Mississippi's own pathologist found two bruises on the back of this young man's head and informed investigators of them early in this investigation," Crump wrote in a statement. "An independent autopsy documented traces of blood and recent blunt force injuries to the back of Nolan's head and his back. To this day, not one person has explained how they got there."
Crump released his team's independent autopsy on Monday night as well. That report recommends keeping the investigation open because of uncertainties surrounding Wells' death and the condition he was in when he entered the water.
According to that report, the investigation doesn't make clear whether Wells entered the water "voluntarily or was forced, whether he was conscious or impaired, or why he would have been unable to extricate himself despite reportedly being able to swim and while in the presence of other persons."
But in her own statement on Monday night, Myers McIllrath said the Crump team has not been acting in good faith. She said they had previously "advised my office that they had no evidence of a crime being committed against Nolan Wells."
Cellphone review caused issues in investigation
Among the issues Myers McIllrath addressed Monday is a dispute over Wells' cell phone.
"The state of Mississippi had no legal avenue to seize and search Nolan's cell phone," she said. "Nolan's family and the Crump team have always been in complete control of Nolan's cell phone, including when, where, how and if the phone would be examined by the state."
Wells' family and attorneys offered to share his phone's data with the state. However, Myers McIllrath said she never received the data or the complete results of the data analysis Crump's team solicited.
"After the grand jury convened in this case, the Crump team provided a 282-page selection of reports from Nolan's cell phone, which the grand jury considered," she said.
However, her office did receive a report from Crump's team that indicated that nothing had been deleted from Wells' phone since his last use, she said.
"The Crump team knew better, but allowed the public to believe, among other false narratives, that our medical examiner withheld Nolan's lungs and stomach when his body was released, that things had been deleted off of Nolan's phone before it was given back to his family, that I refused to cooperate with the examination of Nolan's cell phone, that I refuse to provide Nolan's autopsy results to the family," she said. "All lies."
Civil litigation may still be pursued in the case. On the day of Wells' funeral, attorneys for the family sent letters to Wells' friends and their families as notice that litigation was "reasonably anticipated."
In addition, a former teammate of Wells who went with him to Horn Island on July 4, may sue Wells' family for defamation.

articles.summary_zh: 乡村歌手埃拉·兰利的《选择得克萨斯》第23周蝉联公告牌百强单曲榜第一，打破玛丽亚·凯莉保持的历史纪录。
articles.content_orig:
5 reasons why 'Choosin' Texas' is now the longest-running No. 1 hit of all time
This week, for the 23rd time, country star Ella Langley's "Choosin' Texas" sits at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100. Those 23 nonconsecutive weeks are an all-time record, though the singer's hold on that mantle could well be brief: Langley snatches the record from the Queen of Christmas herself, Mariah Carey, whose 1994 standard "All I Want for Christmas Is You" hit its 19th, 20th, 21st and 22nd week at No. 1 just this past December.
There'll be plenty of questions to answer in the coming months, such as, "Will 'Choosin' Texas' and 'All I Want for Christmas' simply trade places atop the Hot 100, year in and year out, until the heat death of the universe?" and "Could we interest America in a different song, perhaps?" and "Why, God, why?" (Of course, Tuesday brought news of a third potential juggernaut, in the form of a new Taylor Swift single, "Patient Zero," dropping Friday.)
But future-casting can wait for another day. Let's take a look at how we got here — and survey just how and why "Choosin' Texas" has come to define and dominate the pop charts in 2026.
1. It's a good song! Endless repetition at the top of the pop charts can get a little dispiriting — imagine surveying the movie industry's box-office breakdown, only to learn that everyone's still swarming theaters to see F1: The Movie — but we could do, and have done, a lot worse than "Choosin' Texas." A relatable lament about losing a guy to a pretty stranger, "Choosin' Texas" feels surprisingly full-grown for the top of a chart so frequently dominated by youthful pop earworms. It references "Amarillo by Morning"! It's lonesome, it's twangy, it's catchy as all get out, and it's above all timeless; you could imagine it being sung by, say, Tammy Wynette. In a way, it's country's counterpart to the songs of Olivia Dean, in that they'd be hits in any of the past 50 years.
2. The country audience, traditionally served by radio, has shifted to streaming. Setting Mariah aside for a moment, take a look at the other songs to post record-setting runs atop the Billboard Hot 100 in recent years. Behind Langley and Carey, the longest-running chart-toppers, with 19 weeks apiece, are Lil Nas X's "Old Town Road (feat. Billy Ray Cyrus)" and Shaboozey's "A Bar Song (Tipsy)." articles.content_zh:
本周，乡村明星埃拉·兰利的《选择得克萨斯》第23次位居公告牌百强单曲榜第一。这23个非连续周是史上纪录，尽管这位歌手对桂冠的持有可能转瞬即逝：兰利从“圣诞女王”玛丽亚·凯莉手中夺走纪录，凯莉1994年的经典曲目《我要的圣诞礼物就是你》在去年12月刚刚达到第19、20、21和22周位居第一。
未来几个月将有很多问题需要回答，比如：“《选择得克萨斯》和《我要的圣诞礼物》是否会年复一年地在百强榜榜首交替，直到宇宙热寂？”“我们能不能给美国人民换一首不同的歌？”以及“为什么，老天，为什么？”（当然，周二传来第三个潜在巨兽的消息：泰勒·斯威夫特新单曲《零号病人》将于周五发布。）
但预测未来可以改天再说。让我们看看我们是怎么走到这一步的——审视《选择得克萨斯》究竟如何以及为何在2026年定义并主导了流行音乐榜。
1. 这是一首好歌！流行榜顶端无休止的重复可能有点令人沮丧——想象一下调查电影业的票房分布，结果发现大家还是蜂拥去影院看《F1：大电影》——但比起《选择得克萨斯》，我们本可以（也曾经）做得更差。这首歌是一首关于失去爱人给漂亮陌生人的感伤之作，对于常常被年轻流行洗脑神曲主导的榜单顶端来说，它出人意料地显得成熟。它致敬了《Amarillo by Morning》！它孤独、带鼻音、朗朗上口，最重要的是永恒；你可以想象比如塔米·怀内特来唱它。在某种意义上，它是乡村音乐版的奥利维亚·迪恩歌曲，在过去50年的任何时期都会是热门。
2. 传统上由广播服务的乡村听众已经转向流媒体。暂且把玛丽亚放一边，看看近年来其他在百强榜创下纪录性霸榜成绩的歌曲。在兰利和凯莉之后，霸榜最久的冠军单曲各为19周，分别是利尔·纳斯·X的《老城之路》（与比利·雷·赛勒斯合作）和沙布泽的《酒吧歌（微醺）》。这两首都是明确的乡村邻接作品；紧随其后的——

articles.title_orig: Trump signs US-Denmark-Greenland agreement to bolster Arctic security after prolonged tensions
articles.title_zh: 特朗普签署美国-丹麦-格陵兰协议，在长期紧张局势后加强北极安全
articles.summary_zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统与格陵兰岛和丹麦领导人周二签署了一项协议，允许美国扩大在格陵兰岛的军事存在，同时维护丹麦及其自治岛屿领土的主权。
articles.content_orig:
President Donald Trump and the leaders of Greenland and Denmark signed a deal Tuesday allowing the U.S. to expand its military presence in Greenland, while maintaining the sovereignty of Denmark and its autonomous island territory.
"This is tremendous for Europe and for the United States and for everybody and for Greenland," Trump said at a signing ceremony with the other leaders on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York City. "It's going to be incredible."
The deal builds on an existing defense agreement from 1951, under which the U.S. established a presence at Pituffik Space Base. The amended deal signed Tuesday lets the U.S. expand that base and establish two new ones, and leaves the door open for additional defense areas to be built.
The two new sites are at Narsarsuaq, home to just a few dozen residents after the U.S. shut its Bluie West One base in the 1950s, and Mestersvig, a military outpost used by the Sirius Patrol, a Danish special forces unit, Reuters reported.
Trump had announced the deal on Truth Social on Friday, saying it would give the U.S. what he described as "permanent control over security, and all other needs" in the Danish island territory.
Trump has repeatedly insisted during his second term that the U.S. must take control of Greenland for national security reasons, at times declining to rule out the possibility of using military force to acquire it. Trump's demands alarmed Greenlanders and other Europeans and opened a rift between the U.S. and NATO, of which Denmark and the U.S. are both members. Greenland has maintained it is not for sale, and the European Union earlier this year united to rebuke Trump over his push to acquire the island.
Trump signaled in Friday's post that he was satisfied by the new deal, asserting that it addresses "ALL of our many U.S. concerns" and at no cost to the U.S.
The agreement gives the U.S. "the complete ability to do what is necessary to defend the American continent, and also Europe and other places," Trump said during his address at the UN general assembly Tuesday morning before signing the pact.
Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said Friday that the deal "strengthens our common security in the Arctic and the North Atlantic area and therefore is great for NATO and Europe as well."
Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Monday pressed allies of the U.S., including Canada, Denmark, Greenland, Norway and Sweden, to raise defense spending in the Arctic region, his spokesman
articles.content_zh:
唐纳德·特朗普总统与格陵兰岛和丹麦领导人周二签署了一项协议，允许美国扩大在格陵兰岛的军事存在，同时维护丹麦及其自治岛屿领土的主权。
“这对欧洲、美国、每个人和格陵兰岛来说都是巨大的，”特朗普在纽约市联合国大会期间与其他领导人举行的签字仪式上说。“这将是不可思议的。”
该协议建立在1951年的一项现有国防协议的基础上，根据该协议，美国在皮图菲克太空基地建立了存在。周二签署的修订协议允许美国扩大该基地并建立两个新基地，并为建造更多防御区敞开大门。
特朗普在其第二任期内一再坚称，出于国家安全原因，美国必须控制格陵兰岛，有时拒绝排除使用武力获取格陵兰岛的可能性。特朗普的要求震惊了格陵兰人和其他欧洲人，并在美国和北约之间造成了裂痕，丹麦和美国都是北约成员国。格陵兰岛坚称其不可出售，今年早些时候，欧盟联合起来谴责特朗普
据路透社报道，这两个新地点分别位于Narsarsuaq和Mestersvig，前者在20世纪50年代美国关闭了Bluie West One基地后，只有几十名居民居住，后者是丹麦特种部队天狼星巡逻队使用的军事前哨。特朗普周五在Truth Social上宣布了这项协议，称这将使美国“永久控制丹麦岛屿领土的安全和所有其他需求”。他试图夺取这座岛屿。
特朗普在周五的帖子中表示，他对新协议感到满意，声称它解决了“我们所有的许多美国问题”，并且不会给美国带来任何代价。该协议使美国“完全有能力采取必要措施保卫美洲大陆以及欧洲和其他地方”，特朗普在签署该协议前于周二上午在联合国大会上发表讲话时表示。
丹麦首相梅特·弗雷德里克森周五表示，该协议“加强了我们在北极和北大西洋地区的共同安全，因此对北约和欧洲也有好处。”美国国务卿马尔科·卢比奥的发言人周一敦促包括加拿大、丹麦、格陵兰岛、挪威和瑞典在内的美国盟友提高北极地区的国防开支

articles.title_orig: ‘Halo’ to move under Call of Duty publisher as Xbox announces layoffs
articles.title_zh: 随着Xbox宣布裁员，《光环》将并入《使命召唤》发行商
articles.summary_zh: 此消息刚刚发送给全球的Team XBOX员工。
articles.content_orig:
This message was just sent to Team XBOX employees globally.
I’m writing to share several updates as part of the XBOX reset outlined earlier this year.
First, we are eliminating 268 roles across Halo Studios, other first-party studios, and the XGS management and central functions layer. The actions completed since July, inclusive of the studio divestitures, bring us roughly three-quarters of the way through previously announced restructuring. I am deeply grateful for what our colleagues have built, and I know how difficult today will be for those leaving and the teams around them.
Second, we are reorganizing our studios. The goal is to strengthen our franchises and games by operating fewer business units, aligning groups that already work closely together, and focusing our publishing expertise.
- Activision will expand its remit to World’s Edge, as well as Rare. Activision will also be developing the next Halo title, led by a new, purpose-built team that is separate from ongoing development and plans for Call of Duty. A small team at Halo Studios will continue supporting the Halo community and games in-market.
- Bethesda will expand its remit to include Obsidian, which will continue its current projects, including Grounded, as well as the new Fallout project made in collaboration with Bethesda Game Studios.
- King will expand its remit to include Microsoft Casual Games, uniting our two global leaders in casual game design and live operations.
- Playground and Turn 10 will come together as one studio focused on the Forza and Fable franchises. These two studios have been creative and franchise partners for over a decade, and today’s changes will formally move their work into one team.
Third, an update on our studio divestitures: In August, Compulsion and Double Fine returned to management with their IP, back catalogs, and runway funding. Undead Labs has now successfully transitioned on similar terms and, with a new publisher, will release State of Decay 3 day one on Game Pass. Unfortunately, two separate agreements for Ninja Theory fell through. We will now begin consultation with employees on a proposed closure while continuing to explore other paths forward. Consultation with Arkane remains underway and is expected to continue through the end of the year.
Today, our focus should be on supporting those affected and treating one another with care and respect. I will spend time with our studios over the next week. At our October 6 town hall, we will come together as an ALL-XBOX team to reflect on our progress and look ahead to one of the strongest game lineups in our history.
articles.content_zh:
此消息刚刚发送给全球的Team XBOX员工。
我写信是为了分享一些更新，作为今年早些时候概述的XBOX重置的一部分。
首先，我们将取消Halo Studios、其他第一方工作室以及XGS管理和中央功能层的268个角色。自7月以来完成的行动，包括工作室剥离，使我们完成了之前宣布的重组的大约四分之三。我非常感谢我们的同事们所做的工作，我知道今天离开的人和他们周围的团队会有多困难。
其次，我们正在重组我们的工作室。我们的目标是通过减少业务部门的运营、调整已经密切合作的团队以及集中我们的出版专业知识来加强我们的特许经营权和游戏。
-Activision将把其职权范围扩大到World’s Edge和Rare。Activision还将开发下一个Halo游戏，由一个新的专门组建的团队领导，该团队与正在进行的开发和《使命召唤》计划分开。Halo Studios的一个小团队将继续支持Halo社区和市场上的游戏。
-贝塞斯达将扩大其职权范围，将黑曜石纳入其中，黑曜岩将继续其目前的项目，包括《接地》，以及与贝塞斯达游戏工作室合作的新《辐射》项目。
-King将扩大其职权范围，将微软休闲游戏纳入其中，将我们在休闲游戏设计和现场运营方面的两位全球领导者联合起来。
-Playground和Turn 10将合并为一个工作室，专注于Forza和Fable特许经营权。这两家工作室十多年来一直是创意和特许经营合作伙伴，今天的变化将正式将他们的工作转移到一个团队中。
第三，我们工作室资产剥离的最新情况：8月，Compulsion和Double Fine带着他们的知识产权、后备目录和T台资金重返管理层。Undead Labs现在已经成功地以类似的条款进行了过渡，并与新的发行商合作，将在Game Pass上发布《腐烂状态3》的第一天。不幸的是，Ninja Theory的两份单独协议未能达成。我们现在将开始就拟议的关闭与员工协商，同时继续探索其他前进道路。与Arkane的协商仍在进行中，预计将持续到年底。
今天，我们的重点应该是支持受影响的人，关心和尊重彼此。下周，我将与我们的工作室共度时光。10月6日，我们将在市政厅相聚

articles.title_orig: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
articles.title_zh: 根据与丹麦的新协议，美国将在格陵兰岛建立两个军事基地
articles.summary_zh: 根据与丹麦的新协议，美国将在格陵兰岛建立两个军事基地
articles.content_orig:
US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
The US, Denmark and Greenland have signed a defence deal that allows Washington to build two new military bases in the Arctic territory, while reaffirming Copenhagen's sovereignty over it.
Before a signing ceremony at the UN General Assembly in New York, US President Donald Trump said "we will immediately begin the process of developing a large military presence in the appropriate locations".
Danish PM Mette Frederiksen said the deal was "good for the US, Denmark and Greenland" and also for Europe and Nato, while Greenland's PM Jens-Frederik Nielsen said it was a "win-win-win".
The three leaders then inked the deal, seemingly ending more than a year of tension over the Arctic territory.
Trump had threatened to "take" the semi-autonomous Arctic territory over what he said were national security concerns, citing its strategic defence location and its mineral wealth.
His rhetoric prompted outcry from Greenlanders, Danes and European leaders who issued a joint statement saying his words "undermine transatlantic relations and risk a dangerous downward spiral".
The deal amends and updates a 1951 defence agreement between Denmark and the US.
The new pact says the US "shall be allowed to establish an additional Defence Area at Narsarsuaq and Mestersvig" - referring to locations in Greenland's south and east.
Narsarsuaq is a former civilian airport and World War Two base. It has deep-water access and a large runway which US military engineers were recently surveying, the US North Command confirmed to the BBC.
The Mestersvig outpost is remote, far less developed, and used by a Danish naval dog sled unit.
The "modalities and technical details" of the bases are yet to be confirmed, and according to the deal, must be mutually agreed by all parties,
This means the US security arrangements are not unfettered and Greenland and Denmark's approval is still needed.
Washington currently operates its Pituffik Space Base in Greenland's north-west, and the new deal allows the US to "modernise and expand its activities" there.
It also says that "no state that is not a member of Nato shall be allowed to establish its own manned or unmanned military installations in Greenland nor shall they be allowed a persistent presence of military forces in Greenland".
Although the militaries of non-Nato countries are now explicitly barred from the island, it was highly unlikely that non-allied troops would have been allowed access in the first place.
Critically, no territory is ceded to the US, and it recognises both Denmark's "sovereignty and territorial integrity" and Greenland's right to self-determination.
On one hand, that's a significant climb down from Trump's earlier calls to acquire the Arctic island.
But it does deliver a strengthened US military presence and expand on the previous agreement. Therefore to some American eyes, that will be perceived as a historic win.
The new deal must still be approved by both Denmark's and Greenland's parliaments.
Despite months of crisis, the mood at Tuesday's signing ceremony appeared strikingly upbeat and friendly.
"We going to have a tremendous relationship, a secure relationship," Trump said.
"This is tremendous for Europe and for the United States, for everybody, and for Greenland it's going to be incredible."
Meanwhile, Frederiksen described the signing of the deal as a "milestone in our long-standing co-operation".
"Seventy-five years ago we entered into an agreement about the defence of Greenland. Today, we're signing an even bigger and better agreement - a deal that can last forever."
The Danish prime minister stressed that the agreement "respects sovereignty and territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Denmark, as well as Greenland's right to self-determination".
Jens-Frederik Nielsen said that "for Greenland, it is not only an agreement about us, it is [an] agreement with us.
"It takes into account the people of Greenland, our rights, our livelihoods and the development of our country.
"Greenland matters for North American security and for transatlantic security," he said, adding that the Nato had a key role to play in the North Atlantic in a changing security situation.
The agreement also confirmed Greenland would remain in Nato if it were to gain independence from Denmark.
The 1951 agreement already allowed the US to send as many troops as it wanted to Greenland. Washington already has more than 100 military personnel permanently stationed at its Pituffik base.
Trump had tried for months to purchase or annex Greenland, arguing that it was vulnerable to adversaries, including Russia and China.
He argued the Arctic island was an essential piece of his plan to build a futuristic "Golden Dome" defence system to protect the US against missile attacks.
However the deal only mentions the project once, and contains no concrete proposal.
A Nato spokesperson said shortly afterwards that the military alliance welcomed the deal, which would "help advance security, stability and cooperation in this vital region".
In Denmark, the deal is being hailed as a triumph of diplomacy, and several political parties in Denmark have already said they would back it.
For Greenland, a country of 56,000 people, there was good reason for a big sigh of relief. Its leader sat side-by-side with the world's most powerful man, and got a deal that should now bring an end to months of crisis.
articles.content_zh:
根据与丹麦的新协议，美国将在格陵兰岛建立两个军事基地
美国、丹麦和格陵兰签署了一项防务协议，允许华盛顿在北极领土上建立两个新的军事基地，同时重申哥本哈根对该领土的主权。
在纽约联合国大会的签字仪式之前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，“我们将立即开始在适当地点发展大规模军事存在的进程”。
丹麦总理梅特·弗雷德里克森表示，该协议“对美国、丹麦和格陵兰有利”，对欧洲和北约也有利，而格陵兰总理延斯·弗雷德里克·尼尔森表示，这是一场“三赢”。
三位领导人随后签署了该协议，似乎结束了北极领土一年多的紧张局势。
特朗普以其战略防御位置和矿产资源为由，威胁要“占领”这片半自治的北极领土，他说这是出于国家安全考虑。
他的言论引起了格陵兰人、丹麦人和欧洲领导人的强烈抗议，他们发表了一份联合声明，称他的言论“破坏了跨大西洋关系，并有可能陷入危险的恶性循环”。
该协议修订并更新了1951年丹麦和美国之间的国防协议。
新协议称，美国“将被允许在纳尔萨尔苏阿克和梅斯特斯维格建立一个额外的防御区”，这里指的是格陵兰岛南部和东部的地区。
Narsarsuaq是一个前民用机场和第二次世界大战基地。美国北方司令部向英国广播公司证实，它有深水通道和一条大型跑道，美国军事工程师最近正在对其进行调查。
Mestersvig前哨站地理位置偏远，开发程度低得多，由丹麦海军狗拉雪橇部队使用。
基地的“模式和技术细节”尚未得到确认，根据协议，必须得到各方的共同同意，
这意味着美国的安全安排并非不受约束，格陵兰岛和丹麦仍需要批准。
华盛顿目前在格陵兰岛西北部运营着皮图菲克太空基地，新协议允许美国在那里“现代化和扩大其活动”。
它还说，“任何非北约成员国都不应被允许在格陵兰建立自己的有人或无人军事设施，也不应允许它们在格陵兰持续存在军事力量”。
尽管非北约国家的军队现在被明确禁止进入该岛，但非盟军部队被允许进入该岛的可能性极低
